mapper.select: SELECT U.ID, U.JOB_TITLE_ID AS jobTitleId, U.EMAIL, U.PASSWORD_HASH, U.FULL_NAME, R.CODE AS ROLE, U.IS_ACTIVE, U.CREATED_AT, U.UPDATED_AT FROM USERS U LEFT JOIN USER_ROLES UR ON U.ID = UR.USER_ID LEFT JOIN ROLES R ON UR.ROLE_ID = R.ID WHERE U.ID = #{id} AND U.DELETED_AT IS NULL AND U.IS_ACTIVE = TRUE

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.email, u.full_name, string_agg(d.name, ', ' ORDER BY d.name) AS managing_departments_label FROM departments d INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = d.manager_id WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.manager_id IS NOT NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.is_active = TRUE GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.email, u.full_name ORDER BY u.full_name ASC

SELECT DISTINCT U.ID, U.USERNAME, U.EMAIL, U.FULL_NAME, R.CODE AS RANK_CODE, D.NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM USERS U INNER JOIN JOB_TITLES JT ON U.JOB_TITLE_ID = JT.ID AND JT.DELETED_AT IS NULL INNER JOIN RANKS R ON JT.RANK_ID = R.ID AND R.DELETED_AT IS NULL LEFT JOIN USER_DEPARTMENTS UD ON U.ID = UD.USER_ID AND UD.IS_PRIMARY = TRUE LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENTS D ON UD.DEPARTMENT_ID = D.ID AND D.DELETED_AT IS NULL WHERE R.CODE = #{rankCode} AND U.DELETED_AT IS NULL AND U.IS_ACTIVE = TRUE ORDER BY U.FULL_NAME ASC

SELECT DISTINCT U.ID, U.USERNAME, U.EMAIL, U.FULL_NAME, COALESCE(R.CODE, '') AS RANK_CODE, D.NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM USERS U LEFT JOIN JOB_TITLES JT ON U.JOB_TITLE_ID = JT.ID AND JT.DELETED_AT IS NULL LEFT JOIN RANKS R ON JT.RANK_ID = R.ID AND R.DELETED_AT IS NULL LEFT JOIN USER_DEPARTMENTS UD ON U.ID = UD.USER_ID AND UD.IS_PRIMARY = TRUE LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENTS D ON UD.DEPARTMENT_ID = D.ID AND D.DELETED_AT IS NULL WHERE U.DELETED_AT IS NULL AND U.IS_ACTIVE = TRUE ORDER BY U.FULL_NAME ASC

SELECT u.id AS u_id, u.username AS u_username, u.full_name AS u_full_name, u.email AS u_email,
d.name AS d_name, jt.name AS jt_name, r.code AS r_code
FROM users u JOIN user_departments ud ON u.id = ud.user_id JOIN departments d ON ud.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN job_titles jt ON u.job_title_id = jt.id LEFT JOIN ranks r ON jt.rank_id = r.id WHERE ud.department_id IN ( SELECT department_id FROM user_departments WHERE user_id = #{pmUserId} ) AND u.is_active = true AND u.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT ka.id AS asm_id, ka.target_value AS asm_target_value, ka.mid_self_score AS asm_mid_self_score, ka.end_self_score AS asm_end_self_score, ka.end_pm_score AS asm_end_pm_score, ka.status_code AS asm_status_code, ka.evidences AS asm_evidences,
ki.id AS info_id, ki.target_description AS info_target_desc, ki.weight AS info_weight, ki.is_important AS info_is_important,
km.id AS master_id, km.code AS master_code, km.name AS master_name, km.type_code AS master_type_code,
kc.id AS cat_id, kc.name AS cat_name,
u.id AS user_id, u.full_name AS user_full_name,
jt.id AS jt_id, jt.name AS jt_name FROM users u JOIN user_departments ud ON u.id = ud.user_id JOIN departments d ON ud.department_id = d.id JOIN kpi_assignments ka ON u.id = ka.user_id AND ka.cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND ka.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN kpis_information ki ON ka.kpi_info_id = ki.id AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN kpi_master km ON ki.master_kpi_id = km.id AND km.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN kpi_categories kc ON km.category_id = kc.id AND kc.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN job_titles jt ON u.job_title_id = jt.id AND jt.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE d.manager_id = #{pmId} AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY km.code, u.full_name

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) FROM users u JOIN user_roles ur ON u.id = ur.user_id JOIN roles r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE r.code IN ('MEMBER', 'LEADER', 'PM') AND u.is_active = TRUE AND u.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT u.id AS id, u.full_name AS name, u.email AS email, COALESCE(d.name, 'N/A') AS section, COALESCE(d.name, 'N/A') AS division, CASE WHEN COUNT(ka.id) = 0 THEN 'not_started' WHEN COUNT(ka.id) FILTER (WHERE ka.status_code != 603) = 0 THEN 'completed' WHEN COUNT(ka.id) FILTER (WHERE ka.status_code IN (501,502,601,602)) > 0 THEN 'pending' WHEN MAX(kc.end_year_end) < NOW() AND COUNT(ka.id) FILTER (WHERE ka.status_code != 603) > 0 THEN 'overdue' ELSE 'not_started' END AS status, TO_CHAR(MAX(ka.updated_at), 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS lastUpdate FROM users u JOIN user_roles ur ON u.id = ur.user_id JOIN roles r ON ur.role_id = r.id AND r.code IN ('MEMBER', 'LEADER', 'PM') LEFT JOIN user_departments ud ON u.id = ud.user_id AND ud.is_primary = TRUE LEFT JOIN departments d ON ud.department_id = d.id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN kpi_assignments ka ON ka.user_id = u.id AND ka.cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND ka.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN kpi_cycles kc ON kc.id = #{cycleId} WHERE u.is_active = TRUE AND u.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY u.id, u.full_name, u.email, d.name ORDER BY u.full_name
SELECT u.email FROM users u WHERE u.id = #{id} AND u.is_active = TRUE AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT DISTINCT u.email FROM users u JOIN user_roles ur ON u.id = ur.user_id JOIN roles r ON ur.role_id = r.id AND r.code != 'ADMIN' WHERE u.is_active = TRUE AND u.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY u.email

SELECT u.id AS id, u.username AS code, u.full_name AS name, u.email AS email, COALESCE(d.name, 'N/A') AS section, COALESCE(rk.code, 'N/A') AS rank, COALESCE(jt.name, 'N/A') AS jobTitle, CAST(jt.id AS VARCHAR) AS jobTitleId, CASE WHEN u.is_active = TRUE THEN 'active' ELSE 'inactive' END AS status FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_departments ud ON u.id = ud.user_id AND ud.is_primary = TRUE LEFT JOIN departments d ON ud.department_id = d.id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN job_titles jt ON u.job_title_id = jt.id AND jt.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN ranks rk ON jt.rank_id = rk.id AND rk.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN user_roles ur ON u.id = ur.user_id JOIN roles r ON ur.role_id = r.id AND r.code != 'ADMIN' WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY u.full_name

SELECT u.id AS id, u.username AS code, u.full_name AS name, u.email AS email, COALESCE(d.name, 'N/A') AS section, COALESCE(rk.code, 'N/A') AS rank, COALESCE(jt.name, 'N/A') AS jobTitle, CAST(jt.id AS VARCHAR) AS jobTitleId, CASE WHEN u.is_active = TRUE THEN 'active' ELSE 'inactive' END AS status FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_departments ud ON u.id = ud.user_id AND ud.is_primary = TRUE LEFT JOIN departments d ON ud.department_id = d.id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN job_titles jt ON u.job_title_id = jt.id AND jt.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN ranks rk ON jt.rank_id = rk.id AND rk.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE u.id = #{id} AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (id, username, email, password_hash, full_name, job_title_id, is_active) VALUES (#{id}, #{code}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{fullName}, #{jobTitleId, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.company.kpi.common.mybatis.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{isActive})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET full_name = #{fullName}, email = #{email}, job_title_id = #{jobTitleId, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.company.kpi.common.mybatis.UUIDTypeHandler}, is_active = #{isActive}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

WITH RECURSIVE team_tree AS ( SELECT ud.user_id, ud.supervisor_id FROM user_departments ud WHERE ud.supervisor_id = #{pmId}
UNION ALL
SELECT ud.user_id, ud.supervisor_id FROM user_departments ud INNER JOIN team_tree tt ON ud.supervisor_id = tt.user_id ) SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.full_name, jt.id AS job_title_id, jt.name AS job_title_name, tt.supervisor_id, AVG(COALESCE(ka.end_self_score, ka.mid_self_score)) AS self_score, AVG(ka.end_pm_score) AS pm_score,
CASE WHEN MIN(ka.status_code) IS NOT NULL AND MIN(ka.status_code) >= 501 THEN NULLIF( TRIM( CONCAT_WS( E'\n', NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(MAX(uks.evaluation_supervisor_comments), '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(MAX(uks.evaluation_supervisor_comments_promotion), '')), '') ) ), '' ) ELSE NULL END AS pm_comment, MIN(ka.status_code) AS min_status_code, (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ka.status_code IN (501, 601))) > 0 AS requires_pm_evaluation FROM team_tree tt JOIN users u ON u.id = tt.user_id LEFT JOIN job_titles jt ON u.job_title_id = jt.id LEFT JOIN kpi_assignments ka ON ka.user_id = u.id AND ka.cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND ka.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN user_kpi_summaries uks ON uks.user_id = u.id AND uks.cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND uks.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY u.id, u.full_name, jt.id, jt.name, tt.supervisor_id

WITH RECURSIVE team_tree AS ( SELECT ud.user_id FROM user_departments ud WHERE ud.supervisor_id = #{pmId} UNION ALL SELECT ud.user_id FROM user_departments ud INNER JOIN team_tree tt ON ud.supervisor_id = tt.user_id ) SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS userId, u.full_name AS fullName FROM team_tree tt INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = tt.user_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kpi_assignments ka INNER JOIN kpis_information ki ON ka.kpi_info_id = ki.id AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN kpi_master km ON ki.master_kpi_id = km.id AND km.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN sys_status_codes sc ON sc.code = km.type_code AND sc.category = 'KPI_TYPE' WHERE ka.user_id = u.id AND ka.cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND ka.deleted_at IS NULL AND UPPER(TRIM(sc.name)) IN ('INDIVIDUAL', 'TEAM') AND ka.status_code < 501 ) ORDER BY u.full_name
